text: Sir ji aapke HDFC account me 78,000 ka transaction block kar diya gaya hai. Unblock karne ke liye turant is link par jaaye hdfc-unblock-online.site aur netbanking password daaliye, warna paisa wapas nahi milega
Madam ji main Axis bank card department se bol raha hoon. Aapke card par 62,000 ki shopping Dubai me ho rahi hai abhi. Block karwana hai to jaldi se OTP batayein jo abhi aaya hai aapke phone par
Beta main papa bol raha hoon naye number se, purana phone chori ho gaya. Mujhe 35,000 ki emergency hai hospital me, mere dost ke bete ke UPI par bhej do, baad me sab samjhaunga. Please jaldi karo
Congratulations ji!! Aapka number PhonePe lucky draw me 5,50,000 ke liye select hua hai. Claim karne ke liye pehle 4,999 ka processing fee is UPI par bhejein, amount 1 ghante me account me aa jayega

Aunty ji main Sameer, Sharma uncle ka beta. Uncle ko heart attack hua hai aur hospital 2 lakh advance maang raha hai. Humne 1.5 lakh arrange kiya hai, 50,000 short hai. Please help kar dijiye, uncle ne aapka number diya tha
URGENT yaar, main Goa trip par hoon aur wallet kho gaya. Kal return ticket ke liye 6,500 chahiye, is UPI par bhej do, Monday me return karunga. Naya number hai mera, save kar lena

Kaam se ghar baithe 4,000 rozana kamao. Simple copy paste ka kaam hai, koi investment nahi... sorry bhai sirf 1,200 ka activation charge hai. Aaj se pehla payment kal milega, proof channel par hai. Jaldi karo seats limited

Suno, crypto me bahut paisa hai!! Maine 20,000 se 1.8 lakh banaye 2 mahine me. Ye app government registered hai. Mera referral code use karo, dono ko 500 milega. Pehle 5,000 try karo, withdraw kabhi bhi kar sakte ho

Madam aapke bete ne 4.5 lakh ka loan liya hai aur EMIs default kar di hain. Aaj se recovery team aapke ghar aur uske office aayegi. File band karne ke liye 1.2 lakh settlement aaj hi karein, ye last chance hai
Dear customer aapki electricity connection aaj raat 8 baje cut hogi kyunki bill 3,780 pending hai. Abhi is link par pay karein jio-electricity-payments.site, baad me reconnection charge alag lagega

Sir aapki complaint par action lete hue hum batana chahte hain ki aapke account me fraud transaction 45,000 ka attempt hua hai. Transaction rokhne ke liye aapko abhi jo OTP aaya hai wo humein bhejni hogi, phir paisa safe rahega

Didi aapke WhatsApp number ka verification ho raha hai. 6 hours me verify nahi kiya to account delete ho jayega aur aapke saare groups se hat jayenge. Verify karne ke liye is link par apna number aur OTP daaliye

Bhai main Dubai airport par phasa hua hoon. Passport aur paise chori ho gaye. Mujhe 70,000 dirham ke barabar chahiye fine ke liye. Ye mera dost ka number hai, paisa is UPI par bhejo, main India aa kar sab wapas karunga
Sir KYC pending hai aapke gas connection ki. Nayi government rule ke hisaab se subsidy band ho jayegi kal se. Aaj hi is link par Aadhaar link karein aur 99 rupees verification fee jama karein

Ghar walon ko mat batana!! Main tumhare bhaiya ke naam se baat kar raha hoon. Mujhe 80,000 chahiye emergency me, main tumhe cheque de dunga cash ke badle. Aaj hi kaam karna hai, is UPI par bhejo jaldi
Customer care bol rahi hai. Aapka internet 45 minutes me band ho jayega 2,499 ka bill pending hone ki wajah se. Abhi pay kijiye jio-bill-desk.online par, reconnection free milega aaj sirf
Papa ji mera phone paani me gir gaya hai, ye dost ka phone hai. Mujhe 15,000 urgent chahiye, exam form ka last date hai aaj. Is UPI par bhej dijiye, main kal naya phone lekar call karta hoon
Beta aapki LIC policy mature ho gayi hai 6.8 lakh ki. Officer se baat karwata hoon, unhe aapke card details aur OTP deni padegi verification ke liye. Policy amount aaj hi account me aayega

Investment ka golden chance!! Mera bhai ne 30,000 lagaye the, ab 4 lakh ho gaye 8 mahine me. Ye agri farming project hai, government approved. Har mahine 12% return pakka. Aaj hi join karo, seats khatam ho rahe hain

Sir aapke Aadhaar card par illegal website host karne ka case register hua hai Mumbai cyber cell me. Digital arrest me aap hain, video call par hi baat hogi. Case close karne ke liye Supreme Court escrow account me 1.5 lakh verification deposit karein aaj
Madam shipping company se bol rahi hoon. Aapka London se aaya jewelry parcel customs me hai. Duty 22,000 lagti hai, agar na doge to parcel auction ho jayega kal. Jaldi is link par pay karein

Ye mera last message hai. Maine tumhara private video record kar liya hai hack karke. 20,000 ka bitcoin bhejo aaj shaam tak warna video tumhare papa mummy aur office sab ko forward karunga. Police ko mat batana, warna sabse pehle unhe bhejunga

Sir ji aap 10 logon ka group banao, sab 11,000 lagayein. Daily 2,000 milta hai 45 din tak, company ka office Bangalore me hai. Main khud 3 mahine se le raha hoon, payment proof bhejta hoon. Aaj bonus 1,000 extra naye members ko

Hello maam, main Facebook ke verification team se bol raha hoon. Aapka page 10 lakh followers wala copyright strike kha gaya hai. Page save karne ke liye aapko 3,999 ka security deposit karna hoga is UPI par, warna page permanently delete

Bhaiya aapke naam par CBI me complaint aayi hai ki aapne 15 lakh ka fraud kiya hai. Main investigation officer bol raha hoon. Aap arrest se bachna chahte hain to aaj hi sabhi bank accounts ka statement verification ke liye bhejein, aur 50,000 ka deposit karein

Gulf job ka golden chance!! Saudi me driver aur labour ki vacancy hai, salary 1,200 riyal + khana rehana free. Visa ka kharcha 45,000, aadha abhi do, aadha India aane par. Ticket company degi. Aaj hi jama karo, 8 log bhejne hain bas
Aapki Instagram id 3 baar report ho gayi hai fake hone ki wajah se. 12 ghante me verify nahi kiya to account hamesha ke liye band. Jaldi is link par apna username password daal kar verify karo

Sir aapko PM Awas Yojana ka 2.5 lakh milne wala hai, document verification ho gaya hai. Bas 349 ka registration fee is link par jama karein aur amount 7 din me account me transfer ho jayega. Ye government portal hai, chinta mat kijiye

Aunty ji aapka number US me chal raha hai!! Aapke account se 95,000 dollar nikalne wale hain. Main Federal bank officer hoon, sab rok sakta hoon. Aap pehle apna card number, expiry aur CVV batao, main transaction block karunga turant

Bhai trading app try karo!! Main ne 15,000 daale the, ab 1.2 lakh ho gaye 6 hafte me. Roz ka profit 3,000-4,000 nikalta hoon. App ka link bhejta hoon, mere code se join karoge to 1,000 bonus milega. Chhota amount se shuru karo, dekh lena

Maam aapka Canada visa lotterry me select hua hai!! Total process 3.5 lakh me hoga - visa, ticket, sab included. Pehli installment 1 lakh aaj, baaki baad me. Ye government quota hai, agent se bank guarantee milega. Sirf 2 jagah bachi hain

Hello sir, main ITC company se bol raha hoon. Aap consumer draw me 1 lakh ke winner hai!! Prize card aapke ghar courier se aayega, bas 2,800 ka delivery + GST charge is link par pay kijiye. Kal tak nahi kiya to prize cancel

Sir aapke bete ka phone mere paas hai, wo raat ko party me tha. Abhi hum usko le gaye hain security ke paas, usne staff se jhagda kiya hai. 25,000 ka settlement karo aaj, warna police complaint kar denge. Time waste mat karo

Grahak suchna: aapke LPG gas connection par 4,200 ka double subsidy approve hua hai. Isko account me daalne ke liye bank details is government portal par bharein - lpg-subsidy-double.gov-verify.in aur 119 ka charge jama karein

Madamji aapke debit card 4523 se 8,999 ka transaction Maldives me hua hai 2 baje. Agar aapne ye nahi kiya hai, to card freeze karne ke liye abhi jo OTP aaya hai wo is call par batayein. Time nahi hai, transaction complete hone wala hai

Bhai meri beti ki shaadi hai aur mujhe 2 lakh chahiye urgent. Main purana sauda karunga - main tumhe 3 lakh ka purana currency deta hoon 1 lakh me, ye legal hai bank slip ke saath. Aaj hi milta hoon, tumhare colleague ne bataya tha mere baare me

Maam ye CBI officer Vikram Singh bol raha hoon Delhi se. Aapke Aadhaar se 22 lakh ka bank fraud hua hai aur warrant nikal aaya hai. Lekin aap cooperative hain to main file close kar sakta hoon. Aaj 90,000 ka court verification deposit karein aur video call par rahiye

Sir aapke laptop me virus aa gaya hai, aapke saare bank details hacker ke paas ja rahe hain. Main Quick Heal ka certified engineer hoon. Abhi remote access allow karein aur 1,499 ka one time charge karein, sab clean kar dunga turant

Bhabhi ji aapke naam par 2 lakh ki LIC policy bani hai agent ne galat tarike se. ise cancel karne ke liye policy department se baat karni padegi. Main connect kar deta hoon, wahan aapko 5,200 ka cancellation fee dena hoga refund ke saath aayega

Dost ye dekh, aaj maine 8,500 kamaye is app se sirf 1 ghante me!! Ye ek gaming prediction app hai, 90% accuracy hai. Pehle 1,000 daal kar dekh le, profit turant UPI par aayega. Mera link use kar, pehla deposit par 500 extra milega

Sir aapke account ki net banking service 1 January se band ho rahi hai new security update ki wajah se. Continue karne ke liye aaj hi is portal par login karke apni details re-enter karein - sbi-netsecure-renewal.online

Beta ye dekh maine tere liye scholarship form bhara hai - 60,000 rupees har saal milega. Bas 1,800 ka verification fee hai jo scholarship board ko dena hai. Aaj hi daal de, result 2 din me aayega. Ye government scheme hai, sab legal

Hello sir main parle-g company se bol raha hoon. Aap jitna bhi maal khareedenge hamare new wholesale scheme me, 35% discount milega. Lekin membership ke liye 5,999 one time lagta hai. Aaj lo to 1,000 extra product free milega

Ji haan customer ji, aapka refund of 3,240 approve ho gaya hai. Lekin system me technical issue ke karan refund ke liye aapko ek baar apna UPI PIN is portal par daalna hoga - refund-desk-upi.online. Refund turant credit ho jayega

Aapke ghar ke bahar main khada hoon, aapki beti ko maine dekha hai college jaate hue. Aaj shaam 5 baje tak 3 lakh ka packet mere haath pahunche, warna jo bhi hoga uski zimmedari aapki hogi. Police ko bataya to beti ko nuksan hoga

Sir Loan mili hui hai 6 lakh, ab aapki saari property seal ho gayi hai court order se. Kal tak 2 lakh ka partial payment nahi kiya to police aayegi khali haath nahi. Payment karne ka time aaj raat 9 baje tak hai

Madam insurance department se. Aapki mother ki policy claim of 12 lakh process ho rahi hai, but death certificate me name mismatch hai. Correction ke liye 8,400 ka court stamp charge lagta hai. Pay karte hi claim release ho jayega 48 hours me

Sir aapke school me computer lab ke liye government grant of 5 lakh aane wala hai. Principal sir ne aapko volunteer banaya hai is process me. Pehle 4,999 ka documentation charge dena hoga, baad me refund hoga grant ke saath

Bhai jeet gaya aaj 45,000 is cricket prediction app par!! Maine 5,000 lagaya tha match se pehle. Ye legal hai aur instant withdrawal hoti hai. Tu bhi kar le aaj ka match, 2,000 se shuru kar, main guide karunga kaunsa team pe lagana hai

Aapka SIM card 3 din me permanent deactivate hoga DoT ke naye rule ke hisaab se. Aadhaar re-verification mandatory hai sabke liye. Abhi is app se video verification karayein, adhar ready rakhein, 10 minute me ho jayega

Dear sir, main Dubai me job karne gaya tha agent ke through. Wahan Malik ne mera passport rakh liya hai aur kaam nahi mil raha. Mujhe 40,000 chahiye wapas aane ke liye. Please koi bhi karz laga kar bhej do, main aapko naukri laga dunga wahan

Customer ji good news, aapke 5 saal purane credit card par 18,000 reward points pending hain jo aaj raat expire ho rahe hain. Cash me convert karne ke liye abhi is link par 999 ka transfer charge pay kijiye, amount 2 ghante me milega

Sir main State Bank ki head office se. Aapke account me 3 wrong transactions pakde gaye hain total 1.2 lakh ke. Audit ke liye aapko apna card number, expiry date aur CVV is secure form me bhejni hogi. Ye mandatory hai, warna account par legal case lagega

Ye parcel aapke naam par India customs me ruka hai jo aapki online winning ka hai - iPhone 15 Pro Max aur 2 lakh ka cheque. Sirf 5,400 ka import duty lag raha hai. Pay karne ke baad dono cheezein 2 din me ghar par deliver hongi, kal tak pay karo

Maam main bol raha hoon Nokia service center se. Aapke phone me virus aa gaya hai jo aapki photos aur bank apps ko hack kar raha hai. Data bachane ke liye 1,299 ka software cleaning package lo, main remote se abhi clean kar deta hoon

Bhabhi, aunty ko batana mat. Mujhe pata hai aapke ghar ki financial problem chal rahi hai. Main aapko 50,000 dunga bina byaaj ke, bas ek choti si cheez chahiye aapse - aapke bank account se 2,000 ka OTP verification karwana hai mera naam dikhaane ke liye

Sir main income tax department se. Aapki last ITR me 4.5 lakh ki mismatch aayi hai aur notice issue ho chuka hai. Officer se directly baat karke aap settlement kar sakte hain - 25,000 ka compounding fee hai, case court nahi jayega. Aaj hi karein, kal se prosecution shuru

Bhai maine tujhe warn kiya tha us Rajesh se mat milna. Ab usne tere naam par 3 lakh ka cheque bounce karwa diya hai. Advocate ko fee dene padegi 35,000 aaj hi, warna warrant nikal jayega. Main contact kar deta hoon, tu paisa taiyar rakh

Aapke Amazon account par 34,999 ki order place ho gayi hai iPhone 14 ki, payment cash on delivery hai. Agar aapne ye order nahi diya hai, to cancel karne ke liye is toll free number par call karein aur card details verification karayein

Sir aapki shaadi ki hotel booking cancel ho gayi hai payment gateway issue ki wajah se. Full refund 85,000 account me jaana tha but account number galat tha. Correct details is link par daalein aur 1,200 ka reactivation fee dein, refund 2 ghante me aayega

Aunty main bol raha hoon LIC office se. Aapki policy premium 3 mahine se pending hai aur policy lapse hone wali hai. Aapki pura paisa doob jayega. Aaj hi 18,000 ki premium aur 500 late fee is UPI par bhejein, main receipt bhejunga

Sir ji breaking news aapke liye - aapka naam aaye hai Rashtrapati award ke liye social work category me!! Award Delhi me milega. Travel + stay government de rahi hai. Bas 6,800 ka award registration charge hai, aur verification ke liye 2,400. Total 9,200 aaj jama karein
